reason: The plugin primarily enhances the DeepSeek Harness plugin management panel by displaying, searching, editing, and serving bilingual plugin descriptions.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 插件管理页面添加可搜索、可编辑并支持中英文切换的插件功能说明。
summaries.en: Enhances the DeepSeek Harness plugin management page with searchable, editable plugin descriptions in Chinese and English.

capabilities: Adds bilingual descriptions and search matching to plugin-list cards in the DeepSeek Harness Web Settings interface
Provides a pluginDescriptions service for runtime registration and lookup of plugin descriptions
Persists user-edited descriptions in a local JSON dictionary
